payload.title: Later: public conversation on Papyrus sites: forum-style thread pages, posting by signed-in visitors, interactive publications
payload.description:
Deferred direction recorded from Ryan (2026-10-31) while planning the `wire` epic (public pages that show accepted References, recommended References and Message threads mixed with Stories). NOT in scope now; this stub exists so the seams built there are kept.

Direction:
1. An old-web-forum style public view of Message threads that anyone can read, where signed-in visitors can post. Seams left by the wire epic: `_data/wire/threads/<key>.json` per thread (messages in sequence), a reserved thread page base (`urls.wire.threadBase`, default `conversations`), the export's single author-display policy (`wire.threads.authors`), Messages stay people-only (no machine Messages), moderation through the existing `moderateMessage` mutation.
2. Interactive "Web 2.0" publications for sites that opt in: the published `_data/wire/*.json` files plus the islands runtime (`papyrus-islands.js`, `::island{}`) are the mount points; a client component that refreshes the grids from the JSON without a page rebuild is the first step.
3. This extends the public Reference curation on Shipped (reader-steering plugin): visitors help curate References. The `recommended` selection is where reader votes would surface; reader subjects can gain `reference:<key>` keys; reader identity stays the readerId/handle policy already enforced by the reader-privacy scan.

Decisions needed before this starts: identity for public posters (reader accounts epic PPY-1546fc), moderation defaults (AI moderation per the LLM-and-moderation defaults), and which sites opt in. Gherkin specs required for every behaviour change.
